author: Santosh Baral
review_text: eSewa used to be a reliable and trustworthy app, but lately it has become very problematic. Transactions no longer go through smoothly, and almost every time I try to make a payment, some kind of error appears. I even reported these issues to eSewa’s customer support, but nothing has been resolved—even after months. At this point, I’ve lost confidence in eSewa and feel hesitant to make online purchases, constantly worrying that payments might fail or get stuck.
